ex.s: I wasn’t going to take a horse ride by myself anyway.
ex.t: 过了一会儿，保罗叔叔和他的农舍就从视线中消失了。

ex.s: Somehow I couldn’t do it myself, so I went around and got a plain clothes man to do the job.
ex.t: 在亚洲文化中，笑容可以遮掩脆弱的情绪，避免让别人为自己担心。

defs.def: （强调说话者在做某事）我本人，亲自

ex.s: My reaction to the renewed reading no longer corresponded to the original experience, and I was no longer sure that I recognized myself as the same reader.
ex.t: 我对重新阅读的反应不再与最初的体验相符，我也不再确定自己是否还是同一个读者。

defs.def: alone; without anyone else （我）独自，单独

ex.s: Even those who didn’t share that interest with me seemed more engaged once I showed a different side of myself.
ex.t: 即便是那些与我没有共同兴趣的学生，在我展现出不同的一面后，似乎也更投入了。

ex.s: More than once, I found myself wondering just how my students, who’d created these people, knew their subjects so well.
ex.t: 不止一次，我发现自己想知道，创造了这些角色的我的学生们，怎么会如此了解他们所写的人物。

ex.s: I tried to put myself in my brother’s shoes.
ex.t: 我试着把自己放在我哥哥的鞋子里。

ex.s: The following day, called to the headmaster’s office, I found myself accused of stealing the missing parts.
ex.t: 第二天，我被叫到校长办公室，发现自己被指控偷了那些丢失的零件。

ex.s: This year, with an open mind and new knowledge in mind, I walked into another group interview while telling myself I was that cool senior.
ex.t: 今年，带着开放的心态和新知，我走进另一次小组面试，告诉自己我就是那个从容的高年级生。

ex.s: Clearly, my way of reading the text had shifted, and I myself had changed over the years.
ex.t: 显然，我阅读文本的方式已经改变，而这些年来我自己也变了。

ex.s: However, I couldn’t let myself have a go at actually doing it.
ex.t: 然而，我无法让自己真正去尝试做这件事。

ex.s: I woke up most mornings with a dull, grey feeling as I forced myself out of bed to start the day.
ex.t: 大多数早晨我醒来时都带着一种沉闷、灰暗的感觉，强迫自己起床开始新的一天。

ex.s: I needed something to cheer myself up, but I didn’t know what, until that day.
ex.t: 我需要让自己振作起来，但不知道该怎么做，直到那一天。

ex.s: I’ve found myself wondering how we gain pleasure from art.
ex.t: 我发现自己好奇我们从艺术中获得愉悦的方式。

ex.s: I found myself working with a robotics professor on techniques for collecting data from the desert remotely.
ex.t: 我发现自己正与一位机器人学教授合作，研究从沙漠远程收集数据的技术。

ex.s: I went up to my new teammate and introduced myself.
ex.t: 我走向我的新队友并自我介绍。

ex.s: When I returned to London in 2004, I found myself wandering down to Southbank, spending hours there.
ex.t: 2004年回到伦敦时，我发现自己在南岸闲逛，在那里度过几个小时。

ex.s: In the beginning，I dared myself to make a difference in the life of another person．Now that our project is over，I realize that I have affected not only one life，but ten．With our efforts，ten young boys and girls will now be able to further their education．
ex.t: 一开始我鼓起勇气想要改变另一个人的生活。现在我们的项目结束了，我意识到我影响的不只是一个生命，而是十个。通过我们的努力，十个年轻人现在将能够继续接受教育。

ex.s: Today I tried cooking a simply dish myself.
ex.t: 今天我试着自己做了道简单的菜。

ex.s: My mother was not afraid of Mrs Calloway She wished me to have my own library card to check out books for myself.
ex.t: 我妈妈不害怕Calloway太太她希望我有自己的借书证可以自己借书。

ex.s: Then I  42  myself up and kept right on going.
ex.t: 然后，我42自己起来 并保持正确的去。

ex.s: I recorded myself with confidence.
ex.t: 老师让我们录下自己谈论假期的内容。

ex.s: And my shyness has caused me to avoid attending events, not make important connections, and keep my ideas to myself.
ex.t: 我细小的声音让我感到非常害羞。

ex.s: Then I created the Shy and Mighty Society, a space for shy people like me to shine, and in the process of helping others, I could also push myself forward, bit by bit.
ex.t: 于是我创建了“羞怯而强大协会”，一个让像我一样害羞的人发光的地方；在帮助别人的过程中，我也能一点点推动自己前进。

ex.s: I hardly have a minute to myself. ”
ex.t: “我几乎连一分钟属于自己的时间都没有。”

ex.s: They rose in the ranks not by being friendly but by smoking cigarettes, breaking rules and playing jokes on others, among whom I soon found myself.
ex.t: 他们在队伍中的崛起不是因为友好，而是因为抽烟、违反规则和取笑别人，我很快就发现自己就在别人中间。

ex.s: “Today，I just wanted some time to myself，”she said.
ex.t: "今天，我只是想有点属于自己的时间，"她说。

ex.s: I always wanted to know what my mom was reading． Hearing mom say，"I can't believe what's printed in the newspaper this morning，" made me want to grab it out of her hands and read it myself． I wanted to be like my mom and know all of the things she knew． So I carried around a book， and each night， just to be like her， I would pretend to be reading．
ex.t: 我一直想知道妈妈在读什么。听到妈妈说“真不敢相信今天早上报纸上印了什么”，我就想从她手里抢过报纸自己读。我想成为像妈妈那样的人，知道她知道的所有事情。于是我随身带着一本书，每天晚上，就为了像她一样，我还会假装在阅读。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.s: I quickly lower myself, ducking my head to avoid    64    (look) directly into his eyes so he doesn’t feel    65   (challenge).
ex.t: 我迅速蹲下身子，低下头避免____64____（look）直视它的眼睛，以免让它感到____65____（challenge）被挑衅。

ex.s: I had done myself homework but I was shy.
ex.t: 我完成了自己的作业但我很害羞。

ex.s: When I started running in my 30s, I realized running was a battle against myself, not about competition or whether or not I was athletic.
ex.t: 在我30多岁开始跑步时，我意识到跑步是一场与自己的较量，而不是关乎竞争或我是否有运动天赋。

ex.s: I woke up sweating and nervous, but ready to prove something to myself.
ex.t: 我醒来时满身是汗、十分紧张，但已准备好向自己证明些什么。

ex.s: When I look at this picture of myself.
ex.t: 当我看到这张自己的照片时。

ex.s: We could also say Now and then I look at the photo to remind myself that we need to respect all animals, because we are the visitors to their world.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：我不时看看这张照片，提醒自己我们需要尊重所有动物，因为我们是它们世界里的访客。

ex.s: I love to photograph the rising sun, so I force myself into the natural world by waking early each day.
ex.t: 我喜欢拍摄日出，所以我强迫自己每天早起进入大自然。

ex.s: I joined the Boy Scouts because I like to challenge myself.
ex.t: 我加入童子军是因为我喜欢挑战自己。

ex.s: What I wanted to do was just be myself...
ex.t: 我想做的只是做我自己……

ex.s: Tyson left for college, so I had to start at a new school all by myself.
ex.t: 泰森去上大学了，所以我不得不独自在一所新学校重新开始。

ex.s: With no other kids of my age in the neighborhood, I had to spend hours by myself.
ex.t: 因为附近没有我这个年纪的孩子 我不得不一个人呆上几个小时

ex.s: This new start gave me an opportunity to redefine myself and discover an entirely new version of "cool".
ex.t: 这个新的开始让我有机会重新定义自己，并发现一个全新的“酷”的版本。

ex.s: I suddenly found myself out of class before noon time.
ex.t: 然后我到了不得不熬到深夜才能独自完成作业的地步。

ex.s: I found comfort in keeping myself awake when everyone else had gone to bed, and I loved the silence of the night.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的“安静”标志到处都是。如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，随着我渐渐长大，曾经以为如此简单的世界变得越来越复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能抛开烦恼，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成为一个新的角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必记下发生了什么，也不必分析作者写作时运用了什么技巧。我阅读只是为了放松。

ex.s: When I decided to pursue a postgraduate degree, I wanted to develop a novel research programme and quickly establish myself as an independent scientist.
ex.t: 当我决定攻读研究生学位时，我想开发一个新颖的研究项目，并迅速确立自己作为独立科学家的地位。

ex.s: By learning when to ask for help, I eventually found myself on the way to becoming an independent scientist.
ex.t: 通过学习何时寻求帮助，我最终走上了成为独立科学家的道路。
